_readme: Template for a device-local profile. Never put machine.json in the README/release folder. In device-workspace mode set shared.enabled=true and shared.release_root to the parent folder of the README being followed; this applies to W:, other shares, and local copies. Use shared_workspace.py ensure to create/reuse devices/<device-instance>/episodes/<code>. This is required setup but not a gate: the runner auto-resolves it and falls back to isolated local roots if README-folder devices/ is unavailable.
